positions.name: IdGenerationWhenAbsent
positions.frame: how does the memory pipeline produce an identifier when none is explicitly provided?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the precondition — the memory was submitted without an explicit id field — and src-2 directs the pipeline's response: generate a slug from content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Together they answer what happens when identification is absent at submission time.
